name: Bosei ~Mama Club~
source:
The main character, Yuuichi, is a boy who loves his stepmother, Misako. However, it was a typical mother-son relationship until he learned about the "Mama Club".

A secret club at the school that matches boys interested in sex with mothers with incestuous desires. Together, they seek out and enjoy pseudo-incest, that is "mama club"...

Yuuichi accidentally discovers this secret is blackmailed into becoming a member and pressured into having sex with the mothers. Unable to resist the pleasure, he spends his days having sex with an unspecified number of "mama's".

This causes a change in Yuuichi's love for his mother, Misako. What he truly seeks while drowning in pleasure is his stepmother. On the other hand, what are Misako's feelings for Yuuichi...?

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主角雄一是一个深爱继母美沙子的男孩。然而，直到他了解到“妈妈俱乐部”之前，这是一种典型的母子关系。

学校里有一个秘密俱乐部，为那些对性感兴趣的男孩和有乱伦欲望的母亲牵线搭桥。她们一起寻找并享受伪乱伦，那就是“妈妈俱乐部”……

雄一无意中发现了这个秘密，他被勒索成为会员，并被迫与母亲们发生性关系。由于无法抗拒这种快感，他整天与数量不详的“妈妈”发生性关系。

这导致雄一对母亲美沙子的爱发生了变化。他在享乐之中真正寻找的，是他的继母。另一方面，美沙子对雄一的感情又是怎样的呢……？

[来自[url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club.html]官方网站[/url]]
